details: All five interaction robustness checks pass: pointermove only runs a lightweight quadtree find with no re-render; the RAF animation loop is self-terminating and gated on hasFocus; scales are fixed constants with no zoom/brush rescaling so stale closure is not possible; there are no D3 transitions so mid-flight conflicts cannot occur; and the Pointer Events API (pointerdown/pointermove) unifies mouse and touch without double-triggering.
